capabilities: upload pasted and dropped images to Supabase Storage
insert uploaded image URLs as Markdown image links
delete uploaded images from a context menu
organize uploads in date-based folder paths
configure Supabase URL, anon key, and bucket with a connection test
extras: README includes a Network and Data Disclosure section stating images are sent to the user-configured Supabase project and that no telemetry is collected; users must set up a public bucket and SQL storage policies themselves.
problem: Obsidian saves pasted and dropped images as local vault files, which bloats the vault and doesn't work for users who host images externally.
summary: Uploads pasted or dropped images to a Supabase Storage bucket and inserts the remote URL into the note as Markdown.
